verdict.rationale: Netlify documents auto-deploy on every push with per-PR preview URLs, and community users confirm the GitHub integration delivers automated builds and deploys, so the repo-connected deploy workflow is clearly supported. Nothing in the pack shows that Netlify auto-detects frameworks or build settings, so the 'without manual build configuration' part is unproven; one user's netlify.toml confusion concerns the local Netlify Dev server, not repo deploys. Missing for 10: documented automatic framework or build-setting detection, explicit first-party docs on the repo-connect flow, and evidence that builds succeed with no build configuration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Auto-deploy on every push. Every PR gets a preview URL.
The GitHub/Slack integration, automated builds and deploys, and rewrites/reverse proxy support work great.
The real killer bit for me has been their GitHub integration where they render a preview build of any PRs.
